justification: OpenRouter stalled DeepSeek reads for ~15 minutes twice on 2026-10-18; the user asked to call DeepSeek directly. With DEEPSEEK_API_KEY set, the reader calls api.deepseek.com (deepseek-chat, 8,192 output tokens, ample for a 4-page piece of ~3,000); without it, OpenRouter exactly as before.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: the direct key is ignored, OpenRouter changes, or the error is unclear
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Swapping the branch order fails the direct-key test; restored, all pass.

real_layer_exempt.scripts/ai_extractor.py: no DEEPSEEK_API_KEY in .env yet; first live use is the next read once the user adds it

pre_impl.existing_data: held chapters' review rows lack the intro/scope sentences printed on the PDF pages
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: page coverage judges a page by most of its rule lines, so an intro paragraph can be lost on a passed page
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: extends the reader after _reread_skipped_pages; reuses page_coverage.running_lines and doubled_text

functions.name: deepseek_endpoint
functions.input: the environment keys DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_API_KEY and AI_MODEL_ID
functions.output: url, key, model and output token limit for the reader
functions.if_none: raises RuntimeError naming both keys it looked for

break_it.scenario: both keys are set in the environment
break_it.what_happens: the direct DeepSeek API is used

break_it.scenario: only the OpenRouter key is set
break_it.what_happens: the reader behaves exactly as before

break_it.scenario: neither key is set in the environment
break_it.what_happens: a clear error names both keys

post_merge.secrets: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY in the root .env (user adding it)
post_merge.manual_verify: next DeepSeek read logs answers from api.deepseek.com without OpenRouter stalls
